name: Stardew College
source:
Welcome to Stardrop College! The only place in the world to allow Growlers to study! We pride ourselves on our safety to our students we have some the safest technology around to keep you safe! Be sure to apply soon we would love to see you there for our first week very soon!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230901063336/https://blueprintdemon.itch.io/projectstar]Itch.io[/url]]
